Short_description: KCNA?SMOM?Jenks?OLU CD and MD Dry Tensile calcs missing additional dependencies, causing missing inputs in SMOM PASS.
Description:
Issue Summary
CD Dry Tensile and MD Dry Tensile calculations are missing required dependencies on Dry Tensile?STDDEV and Dry Tensile?Range. Because of this, Plant Applications (SMOM client) does not include Tensile?03 and Tensile?04 as calculation inputs, resulting in incorrect Dry Tensile averages.

Description
The CD and MD Dry Tensile average calculations are not fully configured. Unlike CD Wet Tensile, which is working correctly, the Dry Tensile calculations are missing additional dependency links to the associated STDDEV and Range variables.
As a result:

Plant Applications only pulls in partial tensile inputs.
The following variables are missing from the calculation inputs:

OLU_9314_A1_CD Dry Tensile?03
OLU_9314_A1_CD Dry Tensile?04
OLU_9339_A1_MD Dry Tensile?03
OLU_9339_A1_MD Dry Tensile?04



This causes the CD and MD Dry Tensile averages to be calculated incorrectly.

Evidence

Screenshots show CD Wet Tensile includes all four tensile inputs and calculates correctly.
Screenshots for CD Dry Tensile and MD Dry Tensile show missing Tensile?03 and Tensile?04 inputs due to missing additional dependencies.


Impact

CD and MD Dry Tensile averages are inaccurate.
Quality data displayed in Plant Applications is incomplete.


Requested Fix
Add the missing additional dependencies for Dry Tensile?STDDEV and Dry Tensile?Range to both CD and MD Dry Tensile so all tensile inputs (01�04) are included in the calculations.

Once the additional dependencies are added, please reload all affected variables back to the time of GO LIVE on the OLU for SMOM
